feedback.en: The teacher's feedback helped me revise the introduction more clearly.
feedback.zh: 老師的回饋幫助我更清楚地修改前言。

fellow.en: A fellow student showed me how to organize the research notes.
fellow.zh: 一位同學示範如何整理研究筆記。

feminine.en: The article examines how feminine styles have changed across different periods.
feminine.zh: 這篇文章探討女性化風格在不同時期如何改變。

ferry.en: The ferry carries passengers across the harbor every morning.
ferry.zh: 渡輪每天早上載乘客穿越港口。

fertile.en: The valley has fertile soil that supports many kinds of crops.
fertile.zh: 這座山谷有肥沃土壤，適合種植多種作物。

fertility.en: Scientists study soil fertility to understand which crops can grow well.
fertility.zh: 科學家研究土壤肥力，以了解哪些作物能良好生長。

fertilizer.en: The farmer used organic fertilizer to improve the soil before planting.
fertilizer.zh: 農夫在種植前使用有機肥料改善土壤。

fetch.en: Please fetch the reference book from the shelf near the window.
fetch.zh: 請從窗邊的書架拿那本參考書過來。

fever.en: A high fever can be a sign that someone needs medical attention.
fever.zh: 高燒可能表示某人需要醫療照護。

fiance.en: Her fiance joined the family for dinner after the graduation ceremony.
fiance.zh: 她的未婚夫在畢業典禮後和家人一起吃晚餐。

fiancé.en: Her fiancé helped carry the boxes into the new apartment.
fiancé.zh: 她的未婚夫幫忙把箱子搬進新公寓。

fiber.en: Whole grains are a useful source of dietary fiber.
fiber.zh: 全穀類是膳食纖維的良好來源。

fiction.en: Historical fiction can make past events feel more vivid to readers.
fiction.zh: 歷史小說能讓讀者更生動地感受過去事件。

fierce.en: The teams faced fierce competition during the final round.
fierce.zh: 兩隊在決賽中面臨激烈競爭。

fighter.en: The documentary follows a fighter who trains with discipline and patience.
fighter.zh: 這部紀錄片記錄一名格鬥選手以自律與耐心訓練的過程。

filter.en: This filter removes small particles from the water before testing.
filter.zh: 這個濾網會在檢測前去除水中的小顆粒。

fin.en: The fish uses its tail fin to change direction quickly.
fin.zh: 魚利用尾鰭快速改變方向。

fireman.en: A fireman visited the school to explain basic fire safety.
fireman.zh: 一名消防員到學校說明基本防火安全。

fireplace.en: The old house has a stone fireplace in the main room.
fireplace.zh: 這棟老屋的主要房間裡有一座石造壁爐。

fireproof.en: The cabinet is made from fireproof material to protect important records.
fireproof.zh: 這個櫃子使用防火材料製成，以保護重要紀錄。

firewoman.en: A firewoman spoke to the class about emergency preparedness.
firewoman.zh: 一名女性消防員向全班說明緊急應變準備。

firework.en: A single firework lit up the sky during the public celebration.
firework.zh: 公共慶典期間，一枚煙火照亮了天空。

fiscal.en: The report outlines the government's fiscal plan for the coming year.
fiscal.zh: 這份報告概述政府下一年度的財政計畫。

fisherman.en: A fisherman checked the weather forecast before leaving the harbor.
fisherman.zh: 一名漁夫離港前先查看天氣預報。

fishery.en: The coastal fishery supports many families in the small town.
fishery.zh: 沿海漁業支撐這座小鎮許多家庭的生計。

fist.en: He raised his fist in celebration after the team won the match.
fist.zh: 球隊贏得比賽後，他舉起拳頭慶祝。

flake.en: A tiny snow flake landed on her sleeve and quickly melted.
flake.zh: 一小片雪花落在她的袖子上，很快就融化了。

flame.en: The small flame went out when the wind became stronger.
flame.zh: 風變強後，小火焰熄滅了。

flash.en: A bright flash of lightning appeared beyond the mountains.
flash.zh: 一道明亮的閃電出現在群山後方。

flashlight.en: We used a flashlight to read the map during the power outage.
flashlight.zh: 停電時我們用手電筒查看地圖。

flatter.en: Good friends do not simply flatter each other; they also give useful advice.
flatter.zh: 好朋友不只彼此奉承，也會提供有用的建議。

flavor.en: Adding fresh herbs can improve the flavor of a simple soup.
flavor.zh: 加入新鮮香草可以提升簡單湯品的風味。

flaw.en: The reviewer noticed a flaw in the argument and asked for more evidence.
flaw.zh: 審閱者發現論證中的缺陷，並要求更多證據。

flea.en: The veterinarian checked the dog for signs of a flea problem.
flea.zh: 獸醫檢查狗是否有跳蚤問題的跡象。

flee.en: The birds began to flee when the loud machine started nearby.
flee.zh: 附近的大型機器啟動時，鳥群開始逃離。

fleet.en: The company replaced part of its delivery fleet with electric vehicles.
fleet.zh: 公司把部分配送車隊改成電動車。

flesh.en: The peach has soft flesh beneath its thin skin.
flesh.zh: 桃子薄薄的果皮下有柔軟的果肉。

flexibility.en: A little flexibility can help a study plan survive unexpected changes.
flexibility.zh: 一點彈性可以讓讀書計畫因應突發變化。

flexible.en: Our schedule is flexible enough to include an extra review session.
flexible.zh: 我們的時程很有彈性，可以加入一次額外複習。

flip.en: Flip the card over to check the definition on the back.
flip.zh: 把卡片翻過來查看背面的定義。

float.en: A piece of wood can float on water because its density is low.
float.zh: 木頭因密度較低而能浮在水面上。

flock.en: A flock of birds rested in the field before continuing south.
flock.zh: 一群鳥在田野休息後繼續往南飛。

flood.en: Heavy rain caused a flood in several low-lying streets.
flood.zh: 大雨造成幾條低窪街道淹水。

flour.en: The recipe requires two cups of flour and one cup of water.
flour.zh: 這份食譜需要兩杯麵粉和一杯水。

flourish.en: Plants can flourish when they receive enough light and water.
flourish.zh: 植物在獲得足夠陽光與水分時能茁壯成長。

flu.en: Students with the flu should rest and follow medical advice.
flu.zh: 感染流感的學生應休息並遵從醫療建議。

fluency.en: Daily reading can gradually improve your English fluency.
fluency.zh: 每天閱讀可以逐漸提升你的英語流暢度。

fluent.en: She became fluent in English after years of steady practice.
fluent.zh: 她經過多年穩定練習後，英語變得流利。

fluid.en: The scientist measured how quickly the fluid moved through the tube.
fluid.zh: 科學家測量液體通過管子的速度。

flunk.en: One difficult test does not mean you will flunk the entire course.
flunk.zh: 一次困難的考試不代表你會整門課不及格。

flush.en: Please flush the pipe with clean water before starting the experiment.
flush.zh: 開始實驗前，請用清水沖洗管線。

flute.en: She practices the flute for thirty minutes after school.
flute.zh: 她放學後會練習長笛三十分鐘。

foam.en: White foam formed on the surface as the waves reached the rocks.
foam.zh: 海浪拍到岩石時，表面形成白色泡沫。

foe.en: In the story, the former foe eventually becomes a trusted ally.
foe.zh: 故事中，昔日的敵人最後成為值得信任的盟友。

fog.en: Thick fog reduced visibility on the mountain road this morning.
fog.zh: 今早濃霧降低了山路上的能見度。

foggy.en: The morning was foggy, so drivers moved more slowly than usual.
foggy.zh: 早晨霧很濃，因此駕駛比平常開得更慢。

fold.en: Fold the paper in half before cutting along the marked line.
fold.zh: 沿著標記線剪之前，先把紙對折。

folk.en: The festival includes folk music from several regions of Taiwan.
folk.zh: 這個節慶包含來自臺灣不同地區的民間音樂。

folklore.en: Local folklore often preserves stories about a community's past.
folklore.zh: 地方民間傳說常保存社區過往的故事。

follower.en: A careful follower checks information before sharing it online.
follower.zh: 謹慎的追蹤者會先查證資訊再於網路分享。

following.en: Read the following paragraph and identify its main idea.
following.zh: 閱讀下面這一段，找出它的主旨。

fond.en: My grandfather is fond of solving crossword puzzles in the morning.
fond.zh: 我祖父很喜歡早上解填字遊戲。

fool.en: The story warns that pride can make even a wise person act like a fool.
fool.zh: 這個故事警告，驕傲可能讓聰明人也做出愚蠢的事。

foolish.en: It would be foolish to ignore clear evidence in the report.
foolish.zh: 忽視報告中的明確證據是愚蠢的。

forbid.en: School rules forbid students from entering the laboratory without supervision.
forbid.zh: 校規禁止學生在無人指導下進入實驗室。

force.en: The strong force of the wind pushed the door shut.
force.zh: 強風的力量把門吹關了。

forecast.en: The forecast predicts cooler weather and light rain tomorrow.
forecast.zh: 氣象預報預測明天天氣較涼並有小雨。

foreigner.en: The guide explained local customs clearly to each foreigner in the group.
foreigner.zh: 導遊向團體中的每位外國人清楚說明當地習俗。

forever.en: Digital files may not last forever without careful backups.
forever.zh: 如果沒有妥善備份，數位檔案未必能永久保存。

forge.en: The two schools hope to forge a long-term partnership through the exchange program.
forge.zh: 兩所學校希望透過交流計畫建立長期合作關係。

forgive.en: It can take time to forgive someone after a serious disagreement.
forgive.zh: 嚴重爭執後，原諒一個人可能需要時間。

fork.en: Place the fork beside the plate before the guests arrive.
fork.zh: 客人到達前，把叉子放在盤子旁。

format.en: Please use the same format for every section of the report.
format.zh: 請讓報告的每個部分使用相同格式。

formation.en: The diagram shows the formation of clouds above the mountains.
formation.zh: 這張圖顯示山區上空雲層的形成。

formula.en: Use this formula to calculate the area of the triangle.
formula.zh: 使用這個公式計算三角形面積。

forsake.en: The character refuses to forsake his principles even under pressure.
forsake.zh: 這個角色即使面臨壓力也不願放棄自己的原則。

fort.en: The old fort overlooks the harbor from the top of the hill.
fort.zh: 這座古堡從山丘頂俯瞰港口。
